name: Qwen2.5-0.5B causal-LM perplexity screen
limitations: Perplexity screen, not a trained detector — score maps log-PPL between provisional anchors [8, 60] that are NOT yet calibrated on a labeled corpus; recalibrate via deepfake-lens eval before trusting thresholds.
Generator-agnostic in principle (any LLM output compresses toward low PPL under a different reference LM), but effectiveness on a specific generator must be measured, not assumed.
Reference LM is fetched from Hugging Face on first use (~1 GB into the HF cache); set 'hub_model' to a local snapshot directory to run fully offline.
Short texts, templated/boilerplate text, and text written by the reference LM's own family behave differently — the raw ppl value in detail is the auditable signal.
Prioritization signal, not a truth label.
license: Qwen2.5 is Apache-2.0; weights download to the HF cache, never committed
